label: Maternal and newborn care: shared effects

rows.label: Relative risk of neonatal death with community-based maternal and newborn care packages

source.title: Lassi ZS, Bhutta ZA. Community-based intervention packages for reducing maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality and improving neonatal outcomes. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 2015; CD007754, doi:10.1002/14651858.CD007754.pub3
source.quote: neonatal mortality (average RR 0.75; 95% CI 0.67 to 0.83; 21 studies

rows.explainer: Home visits by community health workers and women's groups in pregnancy and after birth: the Cochrane review of 26 cluster-randomised and quasi-randomised trials, random effects, net of their control arms; the confidence interval as the range. An all-cause effect, so no indirect deaths are added. How well a charity's own work fits the trials is in its evidence adjustment.

rows.label: Relative risk of death with kangaroo mother care (any duration) against conventional neonatal care, low birthweight and preterm infants in hospital

source.title: Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews (2026), Kangaroo mother care to reduce morbidity and mortality in low birthweight infants, CD002771.pub5, doi:10.1002/14651858.CD002771.pub5 (abstract, Europe PMC 43039027)
source.quote: Any KMC likely reduces in-hospital mortality or before 40 to 41 weeks' PMA (RR 0.81, 95% CI 0.67 to 0.99; I² = 0%; 14 studies, 4389 participants; moderate-certainty evidence

rows.explainer: The 2026 update of the Cochrane review: 49 randomised trials, mortality from 14 of them, mostly in low- and lower-middle-income countries, fixed effect; the 95% CI is the range. 'Any KMC' spans skin-to-skin durations from short sessions to the WHO's 8 to 24 hours a day (13 trials met that), so it is an effect of kangaroo care as hospitals deliver it rather than of the WHO-defined standard; the review's 2016 version (0.67, 0.48 to 0.95) and the WHO immediate-KMC trial (NEJM 2021, 0.75 against later KMC) sit inside the range. An all-cause effect, so no indirect deaths are added.

rows.explainer: GiveWell's figure for kangaroo care's effect on illness (fewer infections and less hypothermia: the 2026 Cochrane review's sepsis RR 0.66), as a share of the mortality value; the range (5 to 20%) is ours, GiveWell gives a best guess only.
